normalized.normalized: Kintex Ultrascale+ FPGA shall support STANAG3350 / RGB / VGA, DVI, ARINC818 interfaces

normalized.text: PCIe interface: x8 PCIe interface on FPGA MGT bank; Reference clock from clock generator to FPGA MGT bank will be used for PCIe.
normalized.normalized: PCIe interface: x8 PCIe interface on FPGA MGT bank; Reference clock from clock generator to FPGA MGT bank shall be used for PCIe.
